desc:
SWEET AND SALTY: Muddy Buddies Peanut Butter and Chocolate Chex Mix features Corn Chex pieces with a peanut butter and chocolatey layer, and a sweet powdery finish

CUE THE CRUNCH: Snack on little squares of crispiness, where every delectable bite features the satisfying crunch of peanut butter and chocolatey coated Corn Chex

SATISFYING SNACK: Rich and indulgent flavors are just a handful away; Enjoy this treat during lunch time, break time, or just because

CHOOSE YOUR BUDDY: Pick your flavor mix from Muddy Buddies Brownie Supreme, Funfetti, Cookies and Cream, and more; A perfect item for your pantry

CONTAINS: One 9 oz bag of Chex Mix Muddy Buddies Peanut Butter and Chocolate Snack Mix
features:
Features

Classic Muddy Buddies Flavor

Combines crunchy Chex cereal with a rich coating of real peanut butter, chocolate, and powdered sugar.

Perfect Sweet & Salty Balance

Delivers a satisfying mix of creamy, sweet, and slightly salty flavors in every bite.

Snack-Size Convenience

Comes in a portable, resealable pouch—ideal for on-the-go snacking or sharing.

Made with Real Peanut Butter

Offers a rich and authentic nutty flavor without artificial fillers.

Ready-to-Eat Treat

No baking or prep required—simply open the bag and enjoy.

Crunchy Texture with a Smooth Coating

Crispy Chex squares are covered in a soft, melt-in-your-mouth chocolate-peanut butter layer and dusted with powdered sugar.

Family-Friendly Favorite

A well-loved snack among kids and adults alike for road trips, movie nights, or school lunches.

Ideal for Individual or Group Snacking

Great as a solo treat or a party snack everyone can enjoy.

Benefits

Satisfies Sweet Cravings Instantly

Perfect for when you want a quick chocolate or peanut butter fix without going overboard.

No Mess, No Prep

Unlike homemade versions, this comes ready to eat with no cleanup needed.

Portable Indulgence

Easy to toss into a backpack, purse, or lunchbox—great for snacking anywhere.

Balanced Flavor Profile

Offers the comfort of homemade muddy buddies with a consistent, balanced taste.

Kid-Approved and School-Safe

Great for lunchboxes, after-school snacks, or weekend treats.

Better Portion Control Than Homemade

Packaged in a consistent serving size so you can enjoy without overdoing it.

Shelf-Stable and Long-Lasting

Keeps fresh in the pantry, making it a reliable snack to have on hand.
ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Sugar, Dextrose, Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, salt), Vegetable Oil (palm kernel and/or palm), Modified Food Starch, Cocoa Powder. Contains 2% or less of: Color Added, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Distilled Monoglycerides, Baking Soda, Milk, Yellow Corn Flour, Maltodextrin, Artificial Flavor. Freshness Preserved by Calcium Propionate, Citric Acid and TBHQ.
